title: Ivara/Prime
extract:
Release Date: December 17th, 2019
 Ivara Prime is the Primed variant of  Ivara, possessing higher Shields, Armor, Energy and Sprint Speed, as well as an additional  polarity. Ivara Prime was released alongside  Baza Prime and  Aksomati Prime.

Acquisition

Vaulted
On December 10th, 2021, it was announced that Ivara Prime, along with  Baza Prime and  Aksomati Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on December 15th, 2021. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.
Ivara Prime,  Aksomati Prime, and  Baza Prime can occasionally be acquired via Prime Resurgence.

Crafting

Notes
 Ivara Prime, compared to  Ivara:
Higher Shield (455/555 vs. 270/370)
Higher Armor (135 vs. 105)
Higher Energy (250/300 vs. 215/265)
Higher Starting Energy (100 vs. 75)
Higher Sprint Speed (1.2 vs. 1.15)
Additional  Polarity ( vs. )
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.
Ivara Prime along with  Volt Prime,  Chroma Prime,  Saryn Prime,  Baruuk ( Prime),  Wisp ( Prime), and  Yareli, possesses the third highest max-rank energy pool of all Warframes at 300 at rank 30, behind  Yareli Prime's 315 and  Garuda Prime's 320.
This can be increased to 600 with a maxed  Flow, 850 with  Primed Flow, and 880 with Primed Flow and  Endurance Drift.
Ivara Prime also has the highest unranked energy pool of all Warframes at 250.
When Ivara Prime is invisible (such as from  Quiver's Cloak Arrow or  Prowl), she features a moving starlight effect over her body, in addition to typical invisibility. The starlight is always moving from left to right, but moves in relation to a camera movement of a player who observes as well. Its colors are affected by the player's chosen energy colors.
This starlight effect appears to be a part of her model, so it can also be seen when she becomes invisible by other means, e.g.  Untraceable,  Metronome's Nocturne buff, etc.

Trivia
Ivara Prime's design is inspired by jellyfish.
Jellyfish use the transparency of their gelatinous bodies as camouflage. Many of them are so transparent that they are nearly invisible under natural conditions.
Ivara Prime has a single ornate gold-adorned arrow attached to the quiver on her left arm, while her non-Prime counterpart has several.
Ivara's Leverian entry suggests that she did not originally start out as a Prime Warframe and instead had to earn the status.
